BMWCARDATA.NAME: BMW CarData
BMWCARDATA.DESCRIPTION: BMW and MINI vehicles via the official BMW CarData customer API (read only)

CLIENT_ID.NAME: Client ID
CLIENT_ID.DESCRIPTION: Created in the My BMW portal under CarData (Create CarData Client), subscribed to CarData API and, for live values, CarData Stream

POLL.NAME: Poll interval [s]
POLL.DESCRIPTION: One request per vehicle and interval. BMW allows 50 requests a day, a shorter interval is stretched automatically

STREAMING.NAME: Live values (stream)
STREAMING.DESCRIPTION: Connect to the CarData stream. The streamed keys are chosen in the My BMW portal

MQTT_HOST.NAME: Stream host
MQTT_HOST.DESCRIPTION: host:port shown in the portal after configuring the stream

CONTAINER_ID.NAME: Container ID
CONTAINER_ID.DESCRIPTION: Optional: use an existing container instead of letting the driver create one

SCAN.NAME: Search vehicles
SCAN.DESCRIPTION: Lists the vehicles mapped to the account

LOGIN_STATUS.NAME: Login status
LOGIN_STATUS.DESCRIPTION: OK, the login link and code when a login is needed, or the last error

VEHICLE.NAME: Vehicle
VEHICLE.DESCRIPTION: A vehicle of the account (you must be its primary user)

LAST_UPDATE.NAME: Last update
LAST_UPDATE.DESCRIPTION: Newest timestamp of the received values (UTC)

CUSTOM_NUMBER.NAME: Custom number
CUSTOM_NUMBER.DESCRIPTION: Any numeric key of the BMW Telematics Data Catalogue

CUSTOM_TEXT.NAME: Custom text
CUSTOM_TEXT.DESCRIPTION: Any key of the BMW Telematics Data Catalogue
